parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

When connecting to a cloud phone, pass the persistent session ID of the cloud phone instance.
When connecting to a cloud browser, pass the cloud browser ID.
When connecting to a cloud application, pass the application ID for application authorization, the delivery group ID for delivery group authorization, or the persistent session ID for persistent session authorization
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

连接云手机时使用，传入云手机实例对应的持久会话ID。
连接云浏览器时，传入云浏览器ID。
连接云应用时，应用授权场景需要传入应用ID，交付组授权场景传入交付组ID，持久会话授权场景传入持久会话ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The connection properties in JSON format.
The following parameters are supported:

authMode: the authorization mode, determined by the authorization mode of the delivery group. Valid values: App (application authorization), AppInstanceGroup (delivery group authorization), and Session (persistent session authorization).
appInstanceGroupScheduleTags: the delivery group scheduling tags. Multiple tag key-value pairs are supported for filtering. Multiple tag pairs have an AND relationship. Keys must have values, but values can be empty. Example: [{"key":"Resolution","value":"720p"},{"key":"Name"}]
appInstanceGroupIds: the list of delivery group IDs.
appInstancePersistentId: the persistent session ID.
avatarId: the user avatar ID. Default value: default. Used to support allocating multiple session instances to a single user.

When connecting to a cloud phone, pass the fixed value `{"authMode":"Session"}`
parameters.help_zh:
连接属性，为JSON格式。
支持以下参数：

authMode：授权模式，根据交付组的授权模式确定：App：应用授权；AppInstanceGroup：交付组授权；Session：持久会话授权
appInstanceGroupScheduleTags：交付组调度标签，支持多个标签键值对过滤，多个标签对为与的关系，键必须有值，值可以为空。格式示例：[{"key":"Resolution","value":"720p"},{"key":"Name"}]
appInstanceGroupIds：指定交付组ID列表。
appInstancePersistentId：指定持久会话ID。
avatarId：用户分身ID，默认为default，用于支持一个用户分配多个会话实例。

连接云手机时使用，传入固定值`{"authMode":"Session"}`

ResolutionAdaptive.description_en:
Indicates whether adaptive resolution is used.


`true`: The session resolution follows changes in the display area of the terminal. In this case, `SessionResolutionWidth` and `SessionResolutionHeight` are the maximum values for resolution changes.
`false`: The session resolution does not follow changes in the display area of the terminal. In this case, the resolution is fixed to the values of `SessionResolutionWidth` and `SessionResolutionHeight`
ResolutionAdaptive.description_zh:
是否使用自适应分辨率。


`true`：会话分辨率跟随终端显示区域变化。此时`SessionResolutionWidth`和`SessionResolutionHeight`为分辨率变化的最大值。
`false`：会话分辨率不跟随终端显示区域变化。此时分辨率固定为`SessionResolutionWidth`和`SessionResolutionHeight`的值

ResolutionHeight.description_en: The height of the resolution, in pixels
ResolutionHeight.description_zh: 分辨率的高度，单位为像素

ResolutionWidth.description_en: The width of the resolution, in pixels
ResolutionWidth.description_zh: 分辨率的宽度，单位为像素
